build_NSchools_bmgraph: build a BMGraph probabilistic model for the N Schools eightfold hierarchical regression problem
create_NSchools_instance: create an NSchools instance with attrs like num_states, num_districts_per_state, and scale parameters
bind_data_to_bmgraph: bind xarray Dataset observations to the BMGraph model by observing y and sigma values
format_samples_from_bmgraph: format inference samples from a numpy array into an xarray Dataset with draw, state, district dims
review_NSchools_graph: review the NSchools class BMGraph construction including HalfCauchy priors, Normal effects, and StudentT baseline
